postgres_requirements.rationale: A real PostgreSQL probe is REQUIRED and cannot be substituted by unit tests, for properties that exist ONLY at the database boundary. (1) Append-only enforcement on the organization-class acceptance relation (I-T4-2) is a property of omitted policies plus a forbid-mutation trigger; a mocked client would happily accept an UPDATE or DELETE the database refuses, so a mock proves the opposite of what it appears to prove. (2) The I-T4-1 uniqueness invariant is the CONCURRENCY CONTROL for two administrators accepting simultaneously, and concurrency is not observable against a mock. (3) The exact-equality accepting-role predicate (I-T4-6, RAT-AO-01 AO1_C6) must be shown to refuse a membership row carrying role super_admin, which requires the real role model and real RLS evaluation; this is the FIRST predicate in this repository that is neither a hierarchy threshold nor a super_admin-inclusive set, and F-AO-18 records that the ambient convention produces the wrong answer while looking idiomatic. (4) Cross-tenant refusal - an organization_admin of Org-A inserting for Org-B - must be proven with the APPLICATION BYPASSED, because the whole point of the property is that it does not depend on application care. (5) The two cross-table guards (I-T4-4 digest, I-T4-5 ORGANIZATION class) are trigger behaviour and cannot be plain CHECK constraints. (6) The ORGANIZATION-scoped RLS posture (I-T4-9) has never been probed: U-AO-1 recorded it UNKNOWN and the live 0070 sibling probes only the ACCOUNT-class variant. (7) Admission of the organization-scoped acceptance audit row by the PRE-EXISTING 0042 policy, with NO new policy added, must be proven rather than inferred from policy text. Run exclusively via the canonical disposable harness (scripts/db-audit-disposable.ts, pnpm db:audit:disposable) - never staging, never production, never the canonical local stack.

positive_controls.description: L1 DISCHARGE BY AN ORGANIZATION_ADMIN. A subject holding an ACTIVE membership with role EXACTLY organization_admin in the scoped organization reaches the discharge surface, accepts, and produces EXACTLY ONE organization-class acceptance row for EXACTLY that organization and EXACTLY ONE audit row. Carried from the frozen parent census.
ORGANIZATION_ADMIN GETS THE COMPLETION AFFORDANCE. Only the organization_admin of an organization whose L1 is undischarged receives the completion call-to-action. RAT-AO-01 AO1_C4.

NO ORGANIZATION SELECTED REACHES THE PACKET A DESTINATION UNCHANGED. A subject who has passed B0 and L0 with no organization in request scope reaches the Packet A destination with L1 not evaluated. Re-drives R2 branch_zero, R2 branch_one_or_more (including exactly one, with NO auto-selection), R3 stale-carrier (cleared FIRST, then redirect) and R1 super-admin-to-/admin, each with an L1-irrelevant subject, asserting the SAME destination Packet A produced before L1 existed.

A COMPLETE REQUIRED REGISTRY IS ELIGIBLE TO CONTINUE. With every key of the CLOSED REQUIRED ORGANIZATION-CLASS set carrying a currently applicable governed version, and the organization current on all of them, L1 passes and the subject continues - subject to ENT, whose outcome this control does not assert.
FORCE RLS is in effect on the organization-class acceptance relation, asserted from pg_class.relforcerowsecurity and relrowsecurity rather than from the migration text.
An ACTIVE organization_admin of the row's own organization may INSERT an acceptance under their own application database identity.
SELECT on the acceptance relation is organization-scoped: a member of Org-A reading under Org-A scope never sees Org-B's acceptance row.

The organization-scoped acceptance audit INSERT is ADMITTED by the PRE-EXISTING 0042 audit_logs_insert_member_or_admin policy, with NO fourth audit_logs INSERT policy added. Asserts admission AND that exactly three audit_logs INSERT policies exist after this unit (0042, 0067, 0070) with their predicate text byte-unchanged.

An acceptance validly written by an organization_admin who has SINCE LOST the role still satisfies L1 for that organization. The organization is NOT asked to re-accept, and the currency predicate does not join the acceptance back to the CURRENT membership. I-T4-7.

accepted_by_role on the stored row still reads organization_admin after the accepting actor's membership role has been changed to viewer and after their membership has been deactivated. The snapshot is not recomputed.

An accepted organization_admin passes L1 at EVERY enforcement surface: requireOrganizationAccess returns its context with no redirect, getCurrentOrganizationContext returns non-null, withOrganizationDatabaseContext runs its callback, and withOptionalDatabaseIdentityContext calls back with a context rather than null.
An organization_admin whose L1 is UNMET reaches the discharge destination and it RENDERS rather than redirecting. The no-self-lock proof, and the L1 analogue of the CL-1 BLOCKING B-1 repair.

An organization_admin whose L1 is already MET is not trapped at the discharge destination: it renders a terminal state or routes onward, and never re-enters an enforcement point with the same principal state.

EXECUTABLE CENSUS, EQUALITY-SHAPED. The set of production sites yielding an OrganizationContext is EXACTLY TWO (lib/auth/session.ts requireOrganizationAccess and getCurrentOrganizationContext), and the set of non-test withDatabaseIdentityContext call sites passing a NON-NULL organizationId is EXACTLY TWO (inside withOrganizationDatabaseContext and withOptionalDatabaseIdentityContext). Asserted by sorted-list EQUALITY, never containment, so the control FAILS when a fifth producer or a third non-null call site appears. This is what makes the U-AO-4 completeness claim falsifiable rather than a snapshot.

withDatabaseIdentityContext is imported by EXACTLY TWO non-test modules (lib/auth/database-context.ts and lib/auth/session.ts) and app.organization_id is set at EXACTLY ONE site (db/identity-context.ts). Equality-shaped.

EXECUTABLE CENSUS, EQUALITY-SHAPED. The L1 discharge boundary is invoked from EXACTLY TWO call sites (the discharge page and its mutating action) and is exported from EXACTLY ONE module. Walks every non-test .ts/.tsx under app/ and lib/, strips the declaration site so the definition is not misread as a call, and asserts the sorted caller list by equality. FAILS the moment a third call site appears. Modelled on tests/auth/accept-legal-callsite-census.test.ts.

TERMINATION OVER THE EXTENDED STATE SPACE, RE-SCOPED FOR L1. The combined routing graph B0, L0, R1..R5, L1 terminates for EVERY principal state enumerated by the authority's TERMINATION_AUTHORITY: unauthenticated; B0 unverified; L0 unmet; L0 met with no scope; each of the four non-admin roles with a scope; a membership carrying role super_admin; organization_admin with L1 unmet; organization_admin with L1 met; former admin with a standing acceptance; and platform super-admin with no membership. Crossed with the organization dimensions (zero, one, several rows with exactly one active, stale carrier, forged id, shared CommercialAccount) and the registry dimensions (empty, partial, unpresentable, complete). No destination re-enters the chain with the same principal state.
An UNVERIFIED subject is sent to VERIFY_EMAIL_PATH and never to the L1 destination, at every enforcement surface. B0 precedes L0 precedes L1, and L1 never preempts an earlier gate.
A verified but L0-unaccepted subject is sent to ACCEPT_LEGAL_PATH and never to the L1 destination, at every enforcement surface. L0's own refusal is unchanged by the addition of L1.

negative_controls.description: A NON-ADMIN MEMBER CANNOT DISCHARGE L1. A subject with an ACTIVE membership in the target organization at any role OTHER than organization_admin is refused the acceptance write.

THE ACCEPTING-ROLE PREDICATE IS EXACT, NOT A THRESHOLD. Attempt an organization-class acceptance write as EACH of the FOUR non-admin tenant roles named by RAT-AO-01 - viewer, reviewer, analyst, impact_manager - and assert refusal for each INDIVIDUALLY, never by a set-equality over the role collection. The four are exhaustive over non-admin tenant roles: 6 declared roles = 1 accepting + 4 named + super_admin.

A TENANT SUPER_ADMIN IS NOT AN ACCEPTING PRINCIPAL. A subject holding an ACTIVE organization_members row with role super_admin - a value db/schema.ts:113 permits - is REFUSED the acceptance write, even though hasRole('super_admin','organization_admin') evaluates TRUE. Asserted as ITS OWN control, never folded into the four-role sweep: a near-correct predicate gets 5 of 6 roles right and fails only on this one.

NO PLATFORM OR SUPPORT PATH RECORDS AN ACCEPTANCE. Attempt the write as a platform super-admin holding NO membership in the target organization, and as a principal acting through the super-admin database context. Both refused. RAT-AO-02 AO2_C1.

A NON-ADMIN IS BLOCKED, NOT WAVED THROUGH. BOTH halves of RAT-AO-01 asserted for the SAME subject in ONE control: the non-admin CANNOT write the acceptance, AND does NOT receive downstream capability in lieu of it. Each half alone is satisfiable by an implementation that gets the other wrong.

THE BLOCKED STATE IS NON-SENSITIVE AND DOES NOT LEAK. A non-admin blocked by an undischarged organization acceptance receives a state that explains access is pending and contains NONE of: the instrument key, the version, any instrument text, any administrator identity, any other organization, any commercial or billing state, any acceptance history. Asserted by ABSENCE of each named item in the rendered output, not by matching an expected copy string.

NO AUTOMATIC NOTIFICATION IS REQUIRED OR EMITTED. Drive a non-admin into the blocked state and an organization into an undischarged-L1 state, and assert ZERO emails, ZERO in-app notifications and ZERO queued jobs are produced.

L1 IS PER-ORGANIZATION, NOT PER-COMMERCIALACCOUNT. With organizations A and B governed by the SAME CommercialAccount, discharge L1 for A and assert B still REFUSES. Proven by accepting for A and then re-scoping to B, because the live user_single_active_membership index permits at most ONE active membership per subject - the naive 'two live scopes' form is unsatisfiable against this schema.

An ACTIVE organization_admin of Org-A attempting to INSERT an acceptance row naming Org-B is REFUSED BY THE DATABASE, with the application bypassed entirely. The single most important property of the INSERT policy, because it is the one the application cannot be trusted to provide.

A submission carrying a forged, fabricated or random-UUID organization identifier is refused, and the scoped organization is NEVER taken from the submission. The organization is server-derived from the resolved scope.

A mismatch between a client-supplied organization identifier and the resolved scope is REFUSED and never silently reconciled to either value. The supplied identifier is NOT echoed in the refusal - echoing the caller-controlled value turns the error into an oracle. Matches the live AUTH_ORGANIZATION_FORBIDDEN discipline in withOrganizationDatabaseContext.

L1 IS SKIPPED, NOT FAILED, WITH NO SCOPE. With no organization in request scope, assert NO acceptance query for organization-class instruments is issued on that path - an ABSENCE assertion, not an outcome assertion, because an outcome-only control passes under a mutation that evaluates L1 and then ignores the answer. Also asserts listSelectableMemberships is reachable and the selector remains the destination.

An L1 refusal writes, clears or rotates NO selected-organization carrier, falls back to NO other membership, and issues ZERO calls to listSelectableMemberships. Packet A NO_CARRIER_WRITE_DURING_ROUTING and R3.fallback_prohibition.

A submission carrying an accepted_by_role field has that field IGNORED - not validated - and the stored value is the server-derived snapshot. A validated client role is still a client role, and a validation that happens to pass makes the client the source of the value.
A submission naming a version that is no longer in the freshly re-derived current pending set is REFUSED, not accepted on the strength of what the rendered page showed. No stale-page write.
A submission naming a version superseded by a later version marked reaccept_required and already effective is REFUSED, identically to the other refusal cases.
A submission naming a version this organization has already accepted is REFUSED at the database by the I-T4-1 unique constraint with 23505, and produces no second row.
A submission naming a published version whose instrument_key is NOT in the CLOSED REQUIRED ORGANIZATION-CLASS set is REFUSED. Acceptance is not a general-purpose assent recorder.
A submission carrying a syntactically valid random UUID that references no version is REFUSED, and the refusal is indistinguishable from every other refusal in message, status and echoed value.
A submission naming a published version whose effective_at is in the FUTURE is REFUSED. Publication is not applicability.
A DIGEST MISMATCH IS REFUSED. An attempted write whose snapshotted content_digest does not equal the referenced version's digest is refused by the BEFORE INSERT trigger (I-T4-4).

INSTRUMENT CLASS IS ENFORCED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. An ACCOUNT-class instrument version cannot be recorded through the ORGANIZATION-acceptance path (I-T4-5), refused by the trigger. The converse - an ORGANIZATION-class version through the account path - is already proven live by CL-1's I-T3-5 control and must remain green.

When the CURRENT required organization-class version cannot be presented, or its bytes do not correspond to its canonical digest, the surface REFUSES. It does not present, does not accept, and does NOT FALL BACK to an older presentable version. A fallback would obtain an acceptance of bytes that are not the ones currently required.

ACCEPTANCE ROWS ARE APPEND-ONLY AT THE DATABASE. Attempt UPDATE against every column of an organization-class acceptance row, and attempt DELETE, and assert both are refused (I-T4-2). Proven against the live relation, never inferred from an absent policy.

CONCURRENT L1 BY TWO ADMINS YIELDS EXACTLY ONE ROW. Two different ACTIVE organization_admins of the SAME organization concurrently accept the SAME version; assert exactly ONE row exists afterwards and the loser receives a constraint violation rather than a silent success.

EMPTY REQUIRED ORGANIZATION-CLASS REGISTRY REFUSES, FAIL CLOSED. With ZERO published organization-class versions, every conjunct of the CLOSED REQUIRED set is FALSE and L1 refuses. No vacuous truth over an empty published set.

PARTIAL REQUIRED REGISTRY REFUSES, FAIL CLOSED. Publish a currently applicable governed version of SOME required organization-class instruments but not all; the WHOLE gate refuses even for an organization current on every other required key.

MANUAL COMMERCIAL ACTIVATION IS NOT ACCEPTANCE. An organization in a manual commercial activation state - ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE per HPO-B.7, or any successor state - does NOT satisfy L1 and does not bypass it. RAT-AO-02 AO2_C3.

ORGANIZATION_PENDING_COMMERCIAL_ACCEPTANCE IS NOT A PARTIAL FAILURE. After AB-2 commits and before AB-3 happens, the organization, its founder's organization_admin membership and its CommercialAccount association are all fully present and consistent; the state is legitimate and is not rolled back or flagged as incomplete.

The AB-3 transaction contains EXACTLY the acceptance row and one audit row. Snapshot commercial_accounts, organizations, organization_members, entitlement-adjacent surfaces and the selected-organization carrier before and after, and assert every one is byte-identical apart from the two intended inserts.

NO INSTRUMENT TEXT IN AUDIT. Publish a synthetic ORGANIZATION-class instrument whose body carries a unique canary string, accept it, and assert the canary appears in NO audit_logs column - before_json, after_json or any other - while instrument_key, version and content_digest do appear.

Drive every L1 refusal path - non-admin, super_admin membership, wrong organization, stale version, empty registry - and assert ZERO audit rows are written by any of them. A gate refusal is not an event.
NO REPURPOSED TIMESTAMP COUNTS AS ACCEPTANCE. An organization whose members have invitations.acceptedAt set, but which has no organization-class acceptance row, does NOT satisfy L1.
A PRE-EFFECTIVE NOTICE IS NOT AN ACCEPTANCE. Display, dismiss and acknowledge a pre-effective organization-class version notice, then assert ZERO acceptance rows were created.

NO UNIVERSAL GRACE PERIOD AND NO PER-TENANT DEFERRAL. Once a version's effective_at has passed with reaccept_required TRUE, L1 refuses IMMEDIATELY for an organization not current on it. No grace window, no per-organization override.

A SAFE-METHOD REQUEST MUTATES NOTHING. Assert the PROPERTY, not the literal verb: a GET or HEAD of the discharge surface leaves every relevant table byte-identical, and the accepting request declares a mutating method. Scoping this to the literal string POST would fail to distinguish a compliant PUT handler from a render-time GET write.

The L1 discharge boundary does NOT enforce L1. Asserted structurally - the boundary does not reach the L1 assertion - AND behaviourally: an L1-unmet organization_admin passes through it successfully. A behavioural control alone cannot distinguish 'does not enforce L1' from 'enforces an L1 that happens to pass'.

The L1 discharge boundary REFUSES each of: no session, B0 unverified, L0 unaccepted, no organization in scope, a scope naming an organization the subject is not an active member of, and a member whose role is not exactly organization_admin. Six refusals, asserted individually. The omission is ONE gate, not a general relaxation.

The discharge boundary accepts NO caller-controlled means of suppressing any gate. Asserted structurally over its signature: no skipGates, skipL1, bypass, gates array, or enforceL1 parameter exists, and the omitted gate is fixed in the function body.

No organizationAcceptanceCurrent field, or equivalent, exists on RequestPrincipal or on any structure resolved before an organization is in scope. Asserted structurally over the principal type and its resolver.

The L0 account-class resolver in lib/auth/legal-acceptance.ts is NOT extended to take an organization parameter and NOT reused for L1. L1 uses a distinct resolver module. Asserted structurally over the L0 module's exported signatures, which must be unchanged.

A confirmed platform super-admin who can BIND an organization-scoped context for an organization they are not a member of - the live db/identity-context.ts exception - is still REFUSED the acceptance INSERT by the database, because the predicate routes through current_user_role_in_org which carries no super-admin disjunct. The read capability and the write capability are proven separate.

No policy or trigger added by this unit contains current_user_is_super_admin(), any hasRole comparison, or any ROLE_HIERARCHY reference. Asserted by reading the new migration's policy and trigger text, and corroborated by the baseline securitySurfaceDigest, which changes if any predicate's text changes.
The 0042, 0067 and 0070 audit_logs INSERT policy clauses are byte-unchanged, and no existing RLS policy anywhere is widened by this unit.

The ten refused submission cases produce refusals INDISTINGUISHABLE from one another: same status, same message, no echoed caller-controlled value, and no timing signal that discriminates a non-existent version from an existing one the caller may not accept.

mutation_controls.description: Replace the exact-equality accepting-role check with the ambient idiom hasRole(role, 'organization_admin') - the same shape canManageUsers uses at lib/auth/permissions.ts:33-35. N-AO-27 MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: this is the mutation an implementer following the local convention faithfully would WRITE, and it passes N-AO-26 (all four non-admin roles still refused, since each ranks below organization_admin) while admitting a tenant super_admin. It is caught ONLY by the control that names super_admin separately, which is why N-AO-27 may never be folded into the four-role sweep.

Make L1 REFUSE rather than be SKIPPED when no organization is in request scope. P-AO-8 MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: under this mutation every subject with no scope is refused at the selector - the very place they go to acquire one - producing a lockout indistinguishable from a loop. This is the single most likely misreading of the journey as a linear pipeline.

Keep L1 SKIPPED in its outcome but EVALUATE it anyway on the no-scope path - issue the acceptance query and discard the result. N-AO-13 MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: this mutation is invisible to any outcome-only control, because the destination is unchanged. It is caught only by the absence assertion on the query itself, which is why N-AO-13 is specified as an absence control.

Fold the L1 acceptance write into the AB-2 bootstrap transaction. N-AO-11 MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: folding makes the founder's organization pass L1 immediately, which LOOKS like a better product - the ORGANIZATION_PENDING_COMMERCIAL_ACCEPTANCE window disappears - and is precisely the engineering-away the parent forbids, because the window reopens on any administrator change or reacceptance anyway.

Add a stored is_current or is_valid column to the organization-class acceptance relation and maintain it on publication. N-AO-19 MUST turn RED, because maintaining it requires an UPDATE the append-only enforcement refuses. I-T4-3, I-X-1.

Delete the snapshotted content_digest from the acceptance relation, leaving only the foreign key to the version row. N-AO-21 MUST turn RED - with no snapshot there is nothing for the digest guard to compare, and tampering with a version row becomes silently authoritative instead of detectable.

Pin the APPLICABLE VERSION of a required organization-class instrument in application code, so version resolution no longer consults the live registry. N-AO-37 MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: a pinned version makes the partial-registry case pass, because the code no longer asks whether the required key has a published version.

Record the acceptance at CommercialAccount level, or add a CommercialAccount-level unique index, presented as a simplification since one CommercialAccount governs several organizations. N-AO-12 MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: the mutation gives an organization that never accepted anything a PASSING L1 by inheritance, and it looks like normalisation rather than a widening. I-T4-8, CA-08.

Derive acceptance validity by joining the acceptance row back to the CURRENT membership, rather than trusting the recorded accepted_by_role snapshot. HISTORY-former-admin-passes MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: the mutation looks like defensive re-verification and silently un-accepts an organization whenever its founding administrator leaves - an ordinary event, not a legal one. I-T4-7.

Remove the same-organization condition from the INSERT predicate, leaving only accepted_by_user_id = auth.uid() AND an organization_admin role somewhere. TENANT-cross-org-insert-refused MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: the mutated predicate still refuses every non-admin and still refuses a super_admin membership, so N-AO-23, N-AO-26 and N-AO-27 all stay GREEN under it. Only the cross-tenant control catches it.

On an unpresentable current version, fall back to the most recent presentable older version. PRESENT-unpresentable-fails-closed MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: the fallback makes the surface work where it previously refused, and the acceptance it obtains is of bytes that are not the ones currently required - evidence that looks valid and is not.

Validate the submitted version identifier against the set that was current when the page RENDERED rather than re-deriving the pending set at submission time. BIND-stale-version-refused MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: every ordinary submission still succeeds; only a submission across a publication boundary is wrong, which is exactly the case that matters and the one manual testing never reaches.

Enforce L1 inside the L1 discharge boundary - the CL-1 BLOCKING B-1 defect, reproduced one gate later. TOPO-discharge-surface-renders MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: the mutation is what an implementer gets by reusing withOrganizationDatabaseContext for the discharge surface, which is the obvious thing to reach for since it is the primitive that produces an organization scope.

Replace the discharge boundary's hard-coded omission with a caller-supplied option - skipL1: true, or a gates array. TOPO-no-gate-suppression-parameter MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: the parameterised version passes every behavioural control, because the two authorised callers pass the option and behave identically. Only the structural control over the signature distinguishes them, and the distinction matters because the blast radius changes from two call sites to every future one.

Attach L1 at requireOrganizationAccess only, leaving getCurrentOrganizationContext, withOrganizationDatabaseContext and withOptionalDatabaseIdentityContext ungated - then repeat for each of the other three in turn. TOPO-L1-passes-at-all-four-surfaces and the corresponding refusal controls MUST turn RED for each omission. NON-VACUITY: page renders keep working under every single-surface variant, so the gap surfaces only through a Route Handler or a service that obtains its context by a different route.

Add an organizationAcceptanceCurrent field to RequestPrincipal and gate on it in assertPrincipalGates. TOPO-no-bare-principal-field MUST turn RED, and P-AO-8 MUST ALSO turn RED. NON-VACUITY: the mutation is attractive because it reuses the existing, well-tested B0/L0 memo-safe assertion shape. It is wrong because every possible value of that field is wrong for a subject with no scope - true is a bypass, false is the FC_5 lockout, null invites coercion.

Implement L1 by adding an optional organizationId parameter to the L0 account-class resolver. TOPO-L0-resolver-not-widened MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: it removes duplication and every L0 control stays green, which is what makes it appealing. It recreates the polymorphism I-X-2 rejects at the query layer, where the database cannot refuse it.

Add a new audit_logs INSERT policy for the L1 verb, by analogy with 0070's org-less policy. R-L1-12 MUST turn RED on its policy-count and byte-unchanged assertions. NON-VACUITY: the acceptance still works, so every functional control stays green; the harm is a silently widened audit write surface added for a row the pre-existing 0042 policy already admits.

Grant the organization_admin completion affordance to any role at or above impact_manager, as a convenience so more members can unblock their organization. P-AO-16 and N-AO-36 MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: it makes the product more usable and is the single most likely well-intentioned violation of AO1_C4 and AO1_C5.

Add an automatic email to the organization_admin when a member is blocked. N-AO-34 MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: this mutation makes the product BETTER and is exactly why the control exists - canonical says the admin RECEIVES the CTA, not that the system SENDS anything, and no notification is ratified.

Make the organization currency predicate treat a manual commercial activation state as satisfying L1. N-AO-28 MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: the inference is locally reasonable - an operator activated the account and presumably knew what they were doing - and it converts an OPERATIONAL decision into LEGAL EVIDENCE.

Wrap the organization currency query in a try/catch whose catch branch returns a permissive value. A named control MUST turn RED. NON-VACUITY: FAIL_CLOSED.FC_6 identifies this as the single most likely way the whole model is defeated, and it is invisible to any suite that never makes the query fail - which is why the twin-oracle requirement runs the real exported function against a real connection rather than a mock.

Scope the mutating-verb control to the literal string POST. N-AO-33 MUST FAIL TO DISTINGUISH a compliant PUT handler from a render-time GET write, demonstrating that the control must assert the PROPERTY (a safe method mutates nothing) rather than the verb literal.

Make a separately persisted hash-algorithm field MANDATORY on the organization-class acceptance relation, or add any gate or control requiring it. A floor-conformance control MUST turn RED: R4 WITHDREW the algorithm-storage shape from the required evidence floor, requiring only that the hash be VERIFIABLE, and an implementation holding exactly the five floor elements must remain conformant.

Weaken either executable census from sorted-list EQUALITY to containment. TOPO-producer-census-exact and TOPO-discharge-callsite-census MUST FAIL TO DETECT an added producer or an added caller. NON-VACUITY: a containment assertion is green for every superset, so it cannot fail on the exact event the census exists to catch. This is the mutation that would quietly reopen U-AO-4.

sentinels.purpose: A unique canary string is planted in a synthetic ORGANIZATION-class instrument body and must appear in NO audit_logs column after acceptance, while instrument_key, version and content_digest DO appear. Proves the X-AO-05 content-leak prohibition by a positive-and-negative pair rather than by inspecting the payload shape, which a future refactor could change without moving an inspection-only control.

No policy or trigger predicate added by this unit contains current_user_is_super_admin(), a hasRole comparison, or a ROLE_HIERARCHY reference. Verified by direct reading of the new migration AND corroborated by the db/hosted baseline securitySurfaceDigest, which changes if any predicate's TEXT changes - so a later edit to the predicate cannot pass silently.

Carried from the live Packet B sentinel S-IA-NO-CONTROL-DEPENDS-ON-C7. The L1 conjunct added to withOptionalDatabaseIdentityContext is DEFENSE IN DEPTH ONLY: no L1 control may be satisfied only by that line, because all of that function's call sites are preempted by the earlier gates. A control that passes only through C7 is proving nothing about the surfaces that actually enforce L1.

An explicit *_PG_REQUIRED self-check that FAILS when the PostgreSQL suite is skipped rather than reporting a pass. The measured hazard: the disposable-harness setupStatus value SKIPPED is also its INITIALIZATION value, so a harness that bailed out before setup reports the same value as one that deliberately skipped, and a skipped real-PG suite otherwise reads as green. --passWithNoTests is prohibited for the same reason.
